test_title: PYST 38: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is one of the key advantages of the parliamentary system in ensuring smooth governance?

options.text: The judiciary controls both the legislature and the executive.
The executive has absolute power over the legislature.
The Prime Minister can dissolve the legislature at will.
It ensures harmony and cooperation between the legislature and the executive.

solution:
The Correct answer is __**It ensures harmony and cooperation between the legislature and the executive.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **parliamentary system** is designed to ensure a close relationship between the **legislature** and the **executive.**
 
• In this system, the **executive branch**, including the Prime Minister and the Council of Ministers, is drawn from the legislature</stron
